items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Maria in relation to Nat King Cole; Interviewee agrees with the interviewer's assessment but does not claim a personal relationship with Maria.

ctx.x: always played behind himself, with the trio. But to stand up to sing, and concentrate as a -- you know --

Well, I think that was part of the image he wanted or Maria wanted him to be a stand up singer, and I think he thought he wasn't as much of a star if he was accompanying himself. I mean wasn't that the approach?
Well, I think you're right about that.
